notes: ABox contraction of the premise of a derived revision, paired with physics-replace-0016 (which edits "X-rays were discovered in France"): removes "X-rays were discovered by Wilhelm Röntgen" (has_discoverer, functional). Cardinality question: were X-rays discovered by Marie Curie (no before). The one related question uses the inverse: what kind of radiation Röntgen discovered. Derived: the country where the discoverer worked and the discoverer's birth year (both composition: the discoverer is reached by description and a stored fact about Röntgen by name is looked up). Caveat: X-rays are also called Röntgen rays, so the discoverer is recoverable from the name. The 1901 Nobel Prize is not used, since it is stored with the discovery itself.
